fullPassage: Stated simply, we evolved to be as inactive as possible. Or to be more precise, our bodies were selected to spend enough but not too much energy on nonreproductive functions including physical activity. Note that I included the qualifier "as possible" because, obviously, one cannot survive or thrive without moving. As a young hunter-gatherer, you would need to play to develop athletic skills, gain strength, and build stamina. As an adult, you would have no choice but to seek out food, do chores, find mates, and avoid being killed. You would probably also need and want to participate in important social rituals like dancing. But whenever energy is scarce, as it usually was, any gratuitous physical activity would reduce how much energy you could devote to survival and reproduction. No sensible adult hunter-gatherer would waste five hundred calories running five miles just for kicks.

questions.passage: Stated simply, we evolved to be as (A)[active / inactive] as possible. Or to be more precise, our bodies were selected to spend enough but not too much energy on nonreproductive functions including physical activity. Note that I included the qualifier "as possible" because, obviously, one cannot survive or thrive without moving. As a young hunter-gatherer, you would need to play to develop athletic skills, gain strength, and build stamina. As an adult, you would have no choice but to seek out food, do chores, find mates, and avoid being killed. You would probably also need and want to participate in important social rituals like dancing. But whenever energy is (B)[scarce / abundant], as it usually was, any gratuitous physical activity would reduce how much energy you could (C)[deny / devote] to survival and reproduction. No sensible adult hunter-gatherer would waste five hundred calories running five miles just for kicks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 비활동적인(inactive), 부족한(scarce), 헌신하다(devote)가 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① inactive — scarce — devote: 가능한 '비활동적'이도록 진화했고, 에너지가 '부족'할 때, 생존에 '헌신'할 에너지.
❌ ② active — scarce — devote: (A) '활동적인'은 에너지 절약 진화 맥락과 반대.
❌ ③ inactive — abundant — devote: (B) '풍부한'은 에너지가 부족했다는 맥락과 반대.
❌ ④ inactive — scarce — deny: (C) '거부하다'는 에너지를 생존에 쓴다는 맥락과 반대.

As a young hunter-gatherer, you would need to play to develop (B)[academic / athletic] skills, gain strength, and build stamina. As an adult, you would have no choice but to seek out food, do chores, find mates, and avoid being killed. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 번성하다(thrive), 운동의(athletic), 불필요한(gratuitous)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ thrive — athletic — gratuitous: 움직이지 않으면 '번성'할 수 없고, '운동' 기술을 기르고, '불필요한' 활동은 에너지 낭비.
❌ ① perish — athletic — gratuitous: (A) '멸망하다'는 survive와 or로 연결된 긍정적 의미와 반대.
❌ ② thrive — academic — gratuitous: (B) '학문적' 기술은 수렵채집인 맥락에 부적절.
❌ ④ thrive — athletic — essential: (C) '필수적인'이면 에너지 낭비라는 부정적 맥락과 모순.

det.korean: 정확한(precise), 중요한(important), 분별 있는(sensible)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② precise — important — sensible: 좀 더 '정확히' 말하면, '중요한' 사회적 의식, '분별 있는' 성인.
❌ ① vague — important — sensible: (A) '모호한'은 to be more precise의 의미와 반대.
❌ ③ precise — trivial — sensible: (B) '사소한' 의식이면 참여할 필요가 없다는 맥락과 모순.
❌ ④ precise — important — reckless: (C) '무모한'이면 에너지 낭비를 안 한다는 논리와 모순.

questions.passage: Stated simply, we evolved to be as inactive as possible. As a young hunter-gatherer, you would need to play to develop athletic skills, gain strength, and build stamina. As an adult, you would have no choice but to seek out food, do chores, find mates, and avoid being killed. You would probably also need and want to participate in important social rituals like dancing. But whenever energy is scarce, as it usually was, any ①<u>gratuitous</u> physical activity would ②<u>increase</u> how much energy you could devote to survival and reproduction. No ③<u>sensible</u> adult hunter-gatherer would ④<u>waste</u> five hundred calories running five miles just for kicks.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② increase → reduce: 불필요한 활동이 에너지를 '증가'시키는 것이 아니라 '줄이는' 것입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① gratuitous: '불필요한' 신체 활동이라는 문맥 적절.
❌ ② increase → reduce: 불필요한 활동은 생존에 쓸 에너지를 '줄인다'. ← 정답
✅ ③ sensible: '분별 있는' 성인이라는 문맥 적절.
✅ ④ waste: 칼로리를 '낭비하다'는 문맥 적절.

det.analysis:

det.korean: sensible(분별 있는): 합리적이고 현명한 판단을 하는 사람을 의미합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① reasonable: '합리적인'은 sensible과 가장 유사.

det.korean: gratuitous(불필요한, 공짜의): 여기서는 불필요한, 이유 없는 활동을 의미합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ unnecessary: '불필요한'은 gratuitous와 가장 유사.
❌ ① generous: '관대한'은 gratuitous의 '무료' 뉘앙스와 혼동 가능하나 문맥과 다름.
❌ ② grateful: '감사하는'은 형태만 유사.
❌ ④ rewarding: '보람 있는'은 불필요하다는 의미와 반대.
det.tip: gratuitous(불필요한, 이유 없는) = unnecessary, uncalled-for ≠ grateful(감사하는)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 build가 (A)와 (B)에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 체력을 '쌓다/기르다', (B) 공장을 '건설하다'.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 기르다 — (B) 건설하다: (A)는 체력을 '기르다', (B)는 건물을 '짓다'.
❌ ① (A) 건설하다 — (B) 기르다: 의미가 뒤바뀜.
❌ ② (A) 기르다 — (B) 기르다: (B)는 공장을 '기르다'가 아님.
❌ ④ (A) 건설하다 — (B) 건설하다: (A)는 체력을 '건설하다'가 아님.
det.tip: build: ① 건설하다(construct) ② 기르다, 쌓다(develop)

questions.stem:
다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"the ability to sustain prolonged physical or mental effort"

det.korean: 장기간의 신체적 또는 정신적 노력을 지속하는 능력 = stamina(체력, 지구력)
det.analysis:
✅ ② stamina: '체력, 지구력'은 장기간 노력 지속 능력.
❌ ① strength: '힘'은 순간적 힘으로 지구력과 다름.
❌ ③ agility: '민첩성'은 빠른 움직임이지 지구력 아님.
❌ ④ flexibility: '유연성'은 관절/근육의 가동 범위.

questions.passage: No sensible adult hunter-gatherer would waste five hundred calories running five miles just for kicks. Our bodies have __________ (evolve) to conserve energy.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: evolved: have + 과거분사(현재완료)이므로 evolved가 정답입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ evolved: have + p.p.(현재완료) 구조.
❌ evolve: 원형은 have 뒤에 올 수 없음.
❌ evolving: 현재분사는 have 뒤 진행형(have been evolving)에서만 가능.

questions.passage: Any gratuitous physical activity would reduce energy for __________. (survive) Our bodies evolved to minimize unnecessary movement.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: survival: 전치사 for 뒤에 명사가 필요하므로 survival(생존)이 정답입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ survival: for + 명사 구조. survive(동사) → survival(명사).
❌ survive: 동사 원형은 전치사 뒤에 부적절.
❌ surviving: 동명사도 가능하나 원문은 survival.

questions.passage: Stated simply, we evolved to be as inactive as possible. Or to be more precise, our bodies were selected to spend enough but not too much energy on nonreproductive functions including physical activity. Note that I included the qualifier "as possible" because, obviously, one cannot survive or thrive without moving. As a young hunter-gatherer, you would need to play to develop athletic skills, gain strength, and build stamina. As an adult, you would have no choice but to seek out food, do chores, find mates, and avoid being killed. You would probably also need and want to participate in important social rituals like dancing. But whenever energy is scarce, as it usually was, any gratuitous physical activity would reduce how much energy you could devote to __________. No sensible adult hunter-gatherer would waste five hundred calories running five miles just for kicks.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 생존과 번식(survival and reproduction): 에너지를 생존과 번식에 쓸 수 있었다는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ① survival and reproduction: 본문의 핵심 주제로 에너지 배분의 궁극적 목적.
❌ ② athletic skills: 본문에 나오나 젊은 시절 발달 목표이지 에너지 배분 대상이 아님.
❌ ③ physical activity: 에너지를 쓰는 활동 자체이지 에너지를 헌신하는 목적이 아님.
❌ ④ social rituals: 사회적 의식 참여는 에너지 배분 궁극적 목적이 아님.
det.tip: devote A to B: A를 B에 쏟다/헌신하다

det.korean: 음식을 찾고, 집안일을 하고, 짝을 찾고, 죽임을 피해야 한다는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ have no choice but to seek out food, do chores, find mates, and avoid being killed: 원문 그대로 성인의 생존 필수 활동 나열.
❌ ① need to play to develop athletic skills: 어린 수렵채집인의 설명이지 성인(adult)의 의무가 아님.
❌ ② want to participate in important social rituals: 이 문장은 원문에서 그 다음 문장의 내용이므로 빈칸 위치와 불일치.
❌ ③ probably also need to spend enough energy: 에너지를 쓰는 것이지 성인의 구체적 의무 나열이 아님.
det.tip: have no choice but to V: ~할 수밖에 없다
